name: Twad no Monogatari
source:
Main character loses consciousness in a traffic accident. When he wakes up, he is told by some girl that is dead. What does the world after death look like?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一场交通事故中失去意识。醒来时，一名少女告诉他，他已经死了。死后的世界，究竟是什么样子？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
